out.reading: Scarecrow held the birds, but hares are nibbling the young corn. Heavy cold rain keeps birds down, so hares are the threat. Snares are cheap and help the pot. Children's all-day scaring in cold heavy rain is a poor use of their day, so I'll leave them out for now.
out.notes: Day 1: scarecrow only, no signs. Day 2: cold heavy rain; scarecrow worked on birds, but hares nibbled the corn. Set snares and kept the scarecrow. Children stayed home. Loss so far ~1%. If hare damage continues, send the children. Watch for birds once the rain stops.
